About
Me

the short version ↓

I build websites and apps that are simple to use, quick to load, and made to last.

I’m Musayyab Hussain, a web and app developer. My work covers everything from clean business websites to complete web apps — including my own Personal AI Workspace, an AI-powered product with chat, projects, files and integrations.

I care about the details most people skip: how a page feels on a phone, how fast it opens, and whether every single button actually works. Tell me your idea — I’ll tell you honestly how it can be built.

Common
Questions

Quick answers before you message — anything else, just ask me directly.

What services do you offer?

I offer three services: Web Development (websites and web apps), App Development (phone-first apps, including AI features) and UI/UX Design (clean layouts planned before coding). See the Services section for details.

How can I contact you?

The fastest way is WhatsApp — tap any WhatsApp button on this page, or message me on +92 321 7091669. You can also email me at maba.net.56z@gmail.com using the buttons in the Contact section. I reply personally.

Do you build mobile apps too?

Yes — app development is one of my main services. I build phone-first apps that work smoothly on Android and other devices, including apps with AI built in, like my Personal AI Workspace project.

How does a project start?

We discuss your idea on WhatsApp first, then I plan the design, build the full product, and deliver it for your review — you can see the full step-by-step in the Process section above.

Can I play around with code here?

Yes — try the Terminal: type help and it answers like a real command line. There is also a quick coding quiz, a bug-squashing game and a memory match game waiting in the Playground.

Web App · AI Product · Featured

Personal AI Workspace

An all-in-one personal workspace with AI at its centre. It brings chat, project management, file organisation and third-party integrations into a single app — designed to work beautifully on a phone as well as a desktop.

What makes it different is control: every project and file has its own switch for whether the AI can see it, sensitive actions ask for approval first, and a full activity log records everything the AI does. Your data, your rules.
